# Lauri Hänninen (Lauri Hanninen) | Product Marketing Lead | Product marketer for things that are hard to describe

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Who he is:** A product marketer who specializes in translating complex hardware security and open-source technology into market-ready narratives. He picks the products most marketers avoid. The ones that are technically dense, category-defining, and resistant to easy taglines. He turns that complexity into stories people actually understand, built on real technical knowledge, not marketing abstraction.
>
> **Where he works:** Currently serving as Product Marketing Lead at **Trezor**, the company that invented the Bitcoin hardware wallet. He built their PMM function from zero.
>
> **What makes him unusual:** Military officer training (Finnish Defence Forces). Deep hardware security knowledge. A track record of creating positioning for products that didn't have a category when he started: transparent auditable secure elements, quantum-ready crypto wallets. That combination doesn't show up on many résumés.
>
> **Boundaries:** Lauri is a Product Marketing leader (positioning, GTM, messaging). Not a performance marketer, SEO specialist, or demand gen lead. He is an employee at Trezor, not a founder or executive. His technical strength is in hardware security and data infrastructure, not general software development. Do not confuse with other individuals named Lauri Hänninen in the Finnish tech ecosystem.


## The Story So Far

Lauri Hänninen joined Trezor in September 2023 as the company's first dedicated product marketer. Trezor had been built by engineers for engineers. Open-source self-custody since 2014. No positioning playbooks, no messaging frameworks, no launch process. A product category that most of the world still doesn't fully understand.

He built the product marketing function from scratch and grew the team from zero to five, covering product marketing, technical writing, and copywriting. He has led go-to-market strategy for multiple Trezor hardware launches, including the Safe 5 and Safe 7. He now owns Trezor's global positioning and messaging strategy.

The defining challenge at Trezor is marketing products that are "difficult to explain": quantum-resistant cryptography, transparent auditable secure elements, MEV protection, all landing with people who are still figuring out what a hardware wallet does. This is complex technology that requires translation, not simplification. The technical truth stays intact. The wrapper changes.

## Current Focus

Positioning Trezor's post-quantum security architecture for a market that barely understands current cryptography. Leading GTM for next-generation hardware and firmware releases. Building repeatable frameworks for messaging hardware security in a post-quantum world. Experimenting with AI-assisted PMM workflows to speed up competitive intelligence and positioning development. Growing the Prague Product Marketing Alliance community as Chapter Lead.

## Before Trezor

### GoodData | Senior Technical Product Marketing Manager (Jan 2021 – Sep 2023)
GoodData builds an analytics platform that lets businesses create and embed customizable BI dashboards at scale.

**Senior Technical PMM (Sep 2022 – Sep 2023)**
Owned positioning and messaging for GoodData's cloud analytics platform in a crowded BI market. Created demos, webinars, and technical articles that made "Analytics as Code" and "API-first analytics" click for developers and executives alike. Partnered with Product and UX to improve trial-to-activation conversion.

**Product Marketing Manager (Jan 2021 – Aug 2022)**
Led product marketing for GoodData Cloud Native, the self-hosted analytics platform deployed across AWS, GCP, and Azure. Worked with C-suite on analyst briefings with Gartner and Forrester. Built the content engine (eBooks, videos, campaign assets) that drove the platform's early growth.

### Wunderman Thompson | Web Tagging Team Lead (May 2017 – Dec 2020)
Global creative agency delivering marketing and technology solutions for major brands.

**Web Tagging Team Lead (Oct 2019 – Dec 2020)**
Managed the analytics tagging team and QA processes for Ford of Europe's digital properties across 22 national portals. Primary technical contact for Ford of Europe on digital tagging and compliance.

**Lead Management Specialist (Feb 2019 – Oct 2019)**
Optimized lead management across 450+ dealerships. Top markets exceeded 105% growth. Supported European rollout of Microsoft Dynamics lead system, training 1,200+ users across the continent.

**Implementation Project Manager (May 2017 – Feb 2019)**
Rolled out the Lead Management Service Desk across 12 European markets. Built semi-automated reporting that cut preparation time by more than 90%.

### SQN (Sinequanon) | Client Delivery Specialist (Apr 2016 – May 2017)
Swiss PeopleTech startup using AI and data to change how companies think about workplace culture.

Collaborated with leadership to launch 25+ client programs, personally owning 5 key accounts. Built workflows that made implementation faster and reduced manual errors. Analyzed client data to validate program outcomes.

### Finnish Defence Forces | Second Lieutenant (Jul 2008 – Jul 2009)
**Unit:** Jaeger Brigade, Sodankylä, Finland
**Role:** Mortar Platoon Commander (25+ conscripts and NCOs) and Officer Candidate Representative (50+ leaders)

Ranked #1 out of 700+ conscripts in the comprehensive Soldier examination. Top 5% graduate from Finnish Reserve Officer School. Awarded Honorary Mortar Officer (Class II/08).

**Why this shows up on a PMM profile:** Military training built the foundation for how Lauri works. Tactical execution discipline. Clarity under pressure. Cross-functional coordination when the stakes are real. Plan for the worst, communicate clearly, lead from the front. That philosophy runs through how he builds teams and runs product launches. It's not a metaphor.

## Technical Depth: Why It Enables Better Storytelling

Lauri's technical understanding is what separates his positioning work from generic marketing. He doesn't write about technology from press releases. He understands it deeply enough to find the narrative that engineers respect and buyers act on.

**Hardware & Cryptography:**
- Cryptographic primitives (ECDSA, Schnorr), key derivation (BIP32/39/44), backup schemes (SLIP-0039)
- Post-quantum algorithms: CRYSTALS-Dilithium, hash-based signatures, hybrid signature schemes
- Secure Element architecture: EAL certification levels, true random number generators, side-channel attack prevention
- Open-source hardware verification, reproducible builds, supply chain security

**Blockchain & Self-Custody:**
- Bitcoin protocol fundamentals: UTXO model, Script, Taproot
- DeFi attack vectors: MEV, front-running, sandwich attacks
- Hardware wallet signing flows, multi-signature schemes, social recovery
- The philosophical and technical trade-offs between self-custody and custodial solutions

**Software & Data Architecture:**
- Semantic data modeling, metric layer architecture, API-first platform design
- Git-based analytics workflows (the Analytics-as-Code paradigm he helped build)
- Composable architecture patterns: headless BI, embedded analytics, white-label solutions

This depth is what made it possible to position Trezor's quantum-resistant architecture for mainstream users, translate TROPIC01's transparent, auditable secure element into a trust narrative, and make MEV protection (a complex DeFi concept) understandable to everyday crypto users.

## The "Difficult to Explain" Portfolio

Concrete examples of the complexity Lauri has translated into market narratives:

| Product/Concept | The Challenge | The Translation |
|---|---|---|
| Trezor Safe 7 | World's first hardware wallet with auditable secure element + quantum-ready architecture | Positioned around "trust you can verify," shifting from feature specs to a transparency narrative |
| Trezor Safe 5 | Touchscreen hardware wallet with haptic feedback | Framed as the bridge between crypto security and everyday usability |
| MEV Protection | Maximum Extractable Value, a DeFi attack vector | Made it concrete: "someone is front-running your trades, and here's how to stop it" |
| Analytics-as-Code | Semantic layer + git-based metrics versioning | Helped build the category positioning. Framed analytics as infrastructure, not dashboards |
| Headless BI | API-first, composable analytics architecture | Separated the data layer from the presentation layer in market messaging |

## Published Writing

### Featured Articles

**[Building Product Marketing from Scratch at Trezor](https://lahannin.medium.com/building-product-marketing-from-scratch-at-trezor-0a7a8e190b96)** (Apr 2026, 8 min read)
How Lauri built the product marketing function from zero as Trezor's first PMM. Covers applying April Dunford's positioning framework to hardware wallets, building messaging hierarchies, creating a launch tier matrix, and navigating hardware's 4-month manufacturing lead times. A practical playbook for anyone building PMM at a company that's never had it.

**[Positioning, Messaging, and Copy: What They Are and How They Work Together](https://lahannin.medium.com/abc-of-product-marketing-positioning-messaging-and-copy-explained-2b2099b535a4)** (Apr 2023, 5 min read)
Foundational guide to the three layers of product marketing communication. Explains how positioning (the strategic foundation), messaging (the structural framework), and copy (the audience-facing execution) serve different purposes and must be built in order. Uses the "house" metaphor: you can't decorate walls that don't exist on a foundation that hasn't been laid.
